# The PATH folders whose answer depends on the system: the word, a tab, the folder, a tab, the kept form.
# none: left out on every system.
# kept: kept as the third column where it is absolute, else left out.
none	\bin
none	\tools
none	C:bin
none	C:\Go\..\bin
kept	C:\Go\bin	C:/Go/bin
kept	\\host\share\bin	//host/share/bin
kept	/work/a\b/bin	/work/a\b/bin
none	/work/../bin
kept	/work/bin	/work/bin
